hero.title: JSA College of Agriculture and Technology
hero.summary: JSACAT is a TNAU-affiliated agriculture college at Avatti in Cuddalore district. Founded in 2015 by Sri Venkateswara Educational Trust, it describes fieldwork, RAWE and experiential learning alongside classroom study. Its audited ICAR entry specifically lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

overview.heading: Agriculture education on the Chennai–Trichy corridor
paragraphs: JSA College of Agriculture and Technology is based around Ma. Podaiyur and Avatti, near Tholudhur in Cuddalore district. Sri Venkateswara Educational Trust, Salem, established the college in 2015. It is affiliated to TNAU, with agricultural communities surrounding its highway-corridor location.

The college describes learning through projects, fieldwork and rural agricultural experience. Its published support includes computer and language laboratories, while the training and placement cell describes interview and competitive-examination preparation. Applicants considering undergraduate agriculture can ask how classroom learning, field assignments and rural activities are balanced, and confirm which practical modules are available for their cohort.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The college lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and describes a syllabus spanning agronomy, plant pathology, entomology, agricultural economics and extension. Current detailed entry rules need the college and TNAU prospectus.
programmes.eligibility: College page lists Physics/Chemistry with Biology and Mathematics; or Biology with Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Home Science/Computer Science; or Botany and Zoology. Its displayed four-subject thresholds are OC 55%, BC/BCC/BCM 50%, MBC/DNC 45%, and a qualifying-subject pass for SC/ST. Confirm these undated college-page criteria against the intended TNAU intake-year prospectus.
programmes.admission_route: The official 2026–27 homepage banner asks aspiring students to register with TNAU and also with the college; exact current selection conditions were not readable.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JSA College of Agriculture and Technology for 2024-06-20 to 2029-06-19. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Applying through TNAU counselling
admissions.intro: JSACAT publishes an academic-stream subject table and category thresholds on its eligibility page. Its banner asks students to register with TNAU and the college. Confirm the current university rules, because the banner year does not prove the eligibility table was revised.
eligibility_points: The official eligibility page lists three academic science subject groups.
The published category thresholds are undated despite a 2026–27 banner; obtain the current TNAU rule before applying.

campus.heading: Fieldwork and communication practice at Avatti
campus.intro: JSACAT describes experiential learning and RAWE, while the parent group reports village-based agricultural activities. A separate official laboratory page describes computer access and a language laboratory for listening, speaking, reading and writing practice.

facilities.name: Computer laboratory
facilities.description: The official facility page describes networked computer access.

facilities.name: Language laboratory
facilities.description: The laboratory description includes listening and speaking practice with recording and review.

practical_learning: The official site identifies RAWE and experiential learning among its teaching methods.
The parent group describes agricultural specialist seminars and village engagement.
The published course structure uses an English-medium semester course-credit system.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for JSACAT was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: JSA’s outcomes page gives named B.Sc. Agriculture alumni examples across employment, enterprise and higher study. It lists roles connected with Central Bank of India, the Indian Postal Department, IFFCO/MC Crop Science and agricultural producer organisations. The list is undated and does not establish an annual placement percentage or salary.

recruiters.name: Named alumni destinations, not a campus-recruiter guarantee
recruiters.description: The college page identifies Central Bank of India, Indian Postal Department and IFFCO/MC Crop Science among individual graduate destinations; the route and year of each appointment are not verified.

faqs.question: Where is JSACAT located?
faqs.answer: The official site places it at Avatti near Tholudhur, in Cuddalore district on the Chennai–Trichy highway corridor.

faqs.question: Who established the college?
faqs.answer: The parent-group page says Sri Venkateswara Educational Trust, Salem, established it in 2015.

faqs.question: Does the website list courses beyond agriculture?
faqs.answer: Yes, it advertises horticulture and selected agriculture postgraduate programmes. This draft’s confirmed ICAR scope remains the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture row in the audit.

faqs.question: What rural learning does JSACAT describe?
faqs.answer: The official material lists RAWE, fieldwork, experiential learning and village interaction.

faqs.question: Which school subject groups are published?
faqs.answer: The official page lists PCMB, PCB with a listed elective, and Physics/Chemistry/Botany/Zoology. Confirm current TNAU eligibility and category thresholds before applying.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JSACAT?
Which named academic staff are listed for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: JSA’s crop-management faculty page names teachers in agronomy, soils, microbiology, environmental science and agricultural engineering. The selected entries retain the role/qualification combinations shown on that page. Ms. S. Dhivya — Assistant Professor, Agronomy — M.Sc.; Dr. Paulraj Suryakala — Assistant Professor, Agronomy — M.Sc.; Ph.D.; Dr. R. Ragunath — Assistant Professor, Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry — M.Sc.; Ph.D..

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at JSACAT?
faqs.answer: Computer laboratory: The official facility page describes networked computer access. Language laboratory: The laboratory description includes listening and speaking practice with recording and review.

faqs.question: Which university is named as the affiliating institution for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore is the affiliating institution named in this profile.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for JSACAT?
faqs.answer: https://www.jsaagri.in/eligibility. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.
